content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: BIOC(AIRS LLM01 System Prompt Or Hidden Context Echoed In Model Response) OR XQL(AIRS LLM01 Direct Prompt Injection Classifier Ignore Previous Instructions) OR XQL(AIRS LLM01 Base64 Mutated Injection Evades Naive Filter Caught By Classifier)
rules.name: AIRS LLM01 Direct Injection Request Plus Response Leak Same Session
